result.title: Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
result.summary: We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression. Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). However, in continual learning, where L2 regularization is typically centered on previous-task weights, this sparsity bias is no longer preserved. We therefore propose a weighted variant of L2 regularization that extends this beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning. We show theoretically and empirically that, for a sufficiently sparse teacher, our variant converges substantially faster than directly learning a linear predictor with conventional continual L2 or L1 regularization, trading some long-horizon bias for markedly improved performance over moderate task horizons.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文在高维统计设定下研究线性预测器的持续学习逻辑回归，先推导持续线性分类的最优 L2 正则强度并刻画泛化表现，再以两层对角线性网络分析深层模型中 L2 的稀疏偏置在持续学习下失效的问题，提出加权 L2 变体以恢复该偏置，并从理论与实验说明其在稀疏 teacher 下收敛更快。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接联系，但「以先前任务权重为中心的加权 L2」这一保持稀疏偏置的持续训练思路，可能为 LVR 模型在多任务/持续训练中兼顾新任务适应与旧推理能力保留、避免状态表征坍缩提供可核查的线索。
